minor_issues.issue: 生物合成前体归属位置不精确：'原文引言指出两类骨架均可由 γ-bisabolene (bisabolane 型) 前体衍生'，但 'γ-bisabolene precursor' 实际出现在 Section 4 (Conclusion) 而非 Introduction；Introduction 使用的是较笼统的 'bisabolane-type precursor'。
minor_issues.source_locator: PDF p.2 Section 1 / PDF p.4 Section 4
minor_issues.correction: 改为'原文 Conclusion (Section 4) 明示两类骨架均可由 γ-bisabolene 前体衍生 (参考文献 [19])'，并指出 Introduction 仅作 'bisabolane-type precursor' 的笼统表述。

minor_issues.issue: 化合物 4 (widdaranal G) '未作结构修订' 的表述在严格意义上不完全：原文 Section 2 明确指出 'the original structural assignment for widdaranals F and G in the prior literature [16,18] was likely incorrect'，即作者已暗示 G 也可能指派有误，但仅以 X 射线正式确证了 F。建议在'未作结构修订'前添加 '本论文未以晶体学单独对其结构正式修正'的更精确表述。
minor_issues.source_locator: PDF p.2 Section 2, 第 5–6 段
minor_issues.correction: 将'化合物 4 (widdaranal G) 在本研究中未作结构修订'改为'化合物 4 (widdaranal G) 在本研究中未通过 X 射线晶体学单独完成结构正式修订；原文 Section 2 同时指出 widdaranal F 与 G 的原始结构指派均'likely incorrect'，但仅化合物 3 由单晶 X 射线衍射确证'。

verified_claims.claim: 化合物 1 (schisandrin A) 为新化合物，分子式 C15H24O2，HRESIMS m/z 259.1667 [M+Na]+ (计算值 259.1669)
verified_claims.evidence: Schisandrin A (1): Colorless crystal; C15H24O2; HRESIMS m/z 259.1667 [M + Na]+ (calculated for C15H24O2Na+ 259.1669).

verified_claims.claim: 化合物 1 单晶 X 射线衍射 Flack 参数 = 0.01(10)，CCDC 2484530
化合物 3 (widdaranal F) 单晶 X 射线衍射 Flack 参数 = −0.12(18)，CCDC 2484535，标准不确定度较大，X 射线单独无法唯一指派绝对构型
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.4 Section 3.3.6 + PDF p.2 Section 2
verified_claims.evidence: Flack parameter = −0.12(18). CCDC Number: 2484535. ... its large standard uncertainty precluded an unambiguous configurational assignment by X-ray crystallography alone.

verified_claims.claim: 化合物 1 与 2 为 cuparane 型 (五元环经 C6–C7 与六元环融合)，化合物 3 与 4 为 chamigrane 型 (两个六元环经 C6 螺合)
verified_claims.evidence: compounds 1 and 2 are cuparane-type sesquiterpenoids featuring a five-membered ring fused to a six-membered ring via a C6–C7 linkage, while compounds 3 and 4 are chamigrane-type sesquiterpenoids characterized by two six-membered rings connected through a spiro-fusion at C6.

verified_claims.claim: 化合物 3 原被指派为 widdarane 型，本研究以单晶 X 射线衍射修订为 chamigrane 型螺环骨架
verified_claims.evidence: the NMR data of compound 3 had been previously reported in the literature, where it was assigned as a widdarane-type sesquiterpenoid ... The results confirmed that compound 3 possesses a spirocyclic structure.

verified_claims.claim: 化合物 4 NMR 数据与原文献 widdaranal G 一致；原文表述化合物 4 为化合物 2 的衍生化合物
verified_claims.evidence: compound 4, a derivative of compound 2 in this study, also matched the NMR data of widdaranal G.

verified_claims.claim: ECD 计算方法：MMFF94 力场构象搜索 (3 kcal/mol) → M06-2X/def2-SVP 优化 → CAM-B3LYP/def2-TZVP (PCM, MeOH) TDDFT → SpecDis 1.64 Boltzmann 加权
verified_claims.evidence: Conformational analysis was performed using the MMFF94 force field in SPARTAN'16, and conformers within 3 kcal/mol ... Gaussian 09 at the DFT/M06-2X/def2-SVP level ... TDDFT at the CAM-B3LYP/def2-TZVP level in methanol, applying the PCM solvation model ... SpecDis 1.64 ... Boltzmann-weighted summation.
